m1.typescript: m1 a request follows the route table of the gateway

e1.typescript: e1 a team near its budget is moved to a cheaper model and a team over it is refused

e2.typescript: e2 a request is admitted warned or blocked against the budget

e3.typescript: e3 showback adds each teams tokens at the price of the model and refuses an unknown model

e4.typescript: e4 showback rounds each teams total to a cent once

e5.typescript: e5 a caller with a hard latency limit gets accept and poll when the slow case does not fit

e6.typescript: e6 a model pinned by a team is honoured only when the policy allows it

wrong-route-ignores-table.defect: sends every task to the default model

wrong-warn-keeps-model.defect: keeps the expensive model for a team that is near its budget

wrong-block-still-routes.defect: routes a request of a team that is over its budget

wrong-warn-strict.defect: warns only above 80 percent and not at it

wrong-block-at-budget.defect: blocks a request that lands exactly on the budget

wrong-zero-budget-open.defect: lets a team with no budget through

wrong-showback-unknown-free.defect: prices an unknown model at nothing

wrong-showback-by-name.defect: lists teams by name and not by cost

wrong-showback-row-rounding.defect: rounds every row to a cent before adding them

wrong-showback-floors.defect: rounds a team's total down and not to the nearest cent

wrong-delivery-strict.defect: chooses accept and poll when the slow case exactly fits

wrong-delivery-no-margin.defect: leaves the safety margin out of the comparison

wrong-pin-always-honoured.defect: honours any model a team pins
